home.storyLabel: How a custom playground is made

chapters.p: An indoor playground for a family center, café, hotel or preschool. We design it, build it and install it. From the first conversation to handover.

The joint holds the whole structure together. For a playground, that joint is the first conversation. You tell us who the playground is for, how many children will use it and what it should bring to your business. Everything else follows from that.

chapters.h: A frame that fits yo{U}r walls
chapters.p: We measure the space on site: dimensions, ceiling height, entrances, windows and columns. The structure of steel tubes and joints adapts to the room, not the other way round.
You receive a design and a 3D visualization. You can see where the slide, ball pit, tunnel or trampoline will be. We adjust the design with you until the elements, colors and budget all fit.
We wrap the structure in foam and vinyl and enclose the space with nets. The playground meets EN 1176 and EN 1177. We use certified materials and parts only.

We deliver the playground, build it and hand it over ready for operation. We look after it afterwards too: service and annual inspections. Send us the dimensions of your space and what you expect from the playground. We will get back to you with a proposal.

p: The load-bearing structure consists of steel tubes and joints. We wrap it in foam and vinyl, and nets enclose the space. Play elements attach to the structure: slides, tunnels, nets and hanging modules.
The playgrounds meet EN 1176 (playground equipment) and EN 1177 (impact-absorbing surfaces).

rebuild.p: We rebuild an old or low-quality playground into a new, certified one. We reuse material from the original: steel from the structure, joints and undamaged modules. We also do play area upgrades: new padding, colors and features on the original frame.

moving.p: Dismantling and reinstallation of indoor playground equipment: we take it apart, transport it and rebuild it in a new space. We can also resize it along the way. We relocated playgrounds this way in Hlohovec and Králův Dvůr.

rows.p: We service and carry out annual inspections of playgrounds. We assess playgrounds according to EN 1176 (playground equipment) and EN 1177 (impact-absorbing surfaces).
In stock we have structural tubes, joints, nets, foam for wrapping the structure and hanging modules. We also replace the protective padding on the frame.
